entries.wording: Your package is being prepared at the sender's warehouse.
entries.note: The sender is preparing the parcel; SUE does not hold it yet. The French page says Votre colis est en cours de préparation chez l'expéditeur.

entries.wording: Your package arrived at the SUE center in Amsterdam.
entries.note: The town of SUE's center follows the wording; the progress bar then shows the parcel in transit in the shipping country.

entries.wording: Your package is in our hands
entries.note: The summary's status above the rows, not a row: SUE holds the parcel. The French page says Votre colis a été pris en charge.
